about_the_game:
GraeHart is an immersive medieval fantasy 16-Bit RPG, launching as early access in 2025. Step into the role of Percival, a hunter battling to protect his village and uncover dark forces threatening the realm. Explore vast regions, forge alliances, and face challenging enemies in a rich, story-driven world. 

A multiplayer mode with PvP, PvE, in an Arena mode for epic battles will be introduced post-launch, along with guilds for deeper cooperative gameplay. Your choices will shape the fate of GraeHart!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8/8.1/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or i7 (8th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 or 7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 and above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
